4 LAY &S Renewal of Clinical Affiliation Agreement between the Nashville Fire Department and Volunteer State Community College WHEREAS, the Nashville Fire Department and Volunteer State Community College have entered into a clinical affiliation agreement, a copy of which is attached hereto, for the participation and clinical training of students enrolled in the Emergency Medical Technician Programs of the institution; and, WHEREAS, Tennessee Code Annotated Section 12-9-104 provides for approval of intergovernmental agreements by Resolution; and, WHEREAS, the Council of the Metropolitan Government approved the clinical affiliation agreement by Resolution No. RS2013-888; - WHEREAS, the clinical affiliation agreement provides that it may be renewed annually with written approval of all parties for a total term of up to five (5) years; NOW, THEREFORE, the parties, by their signatures, indicate their written approval to renew the clinical affiliation agreement for the one year term of September 1, 2017 through August 31, 2018. {NO151556.1} ARCHIVE
